title: BITCOIN URGENT UPDATE: It's Getting Worse (for now)!!! - Bitcoin News Today, Ethereum & Altcoins
speaker: Josh (Crypto World)

macro_themes.view: CPI at 3.7% vs 3.6% expected is slightly bearish; markets now price about four 25bp hikes by mid next year, including possibly two more this year, pressuring stocks and crypto short term.
Unless inflation keeps worsening, the market should absorb the repricing and could rebound within weeks or months.
BTC dominance is nearing 60.5-61% range resistance; a rejection in a few weeks could let some altcoins outperform, but a confirmed break above ~61.5% would likely crush altcoins.
The US stock pullback from last week's all-time high is weighing on crypto in the short term.

calls.reason: Daily bearish divergence plus CPI-driven repricing of Fed hikes means weakness into the 80-82K support with liquidity near 80.2-80.3K; weekly supertrend green and weekly bullish divergence remain long-term bullish.
calls.quote: this suggests a likely scenario for the price of Bitcoin testing well into this support in the coming hours or days
